input.title: bumpThoughtDown: Bumped thought is not sorted
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

```
- C
  - =sort
    - Alphabetical
      - Asc
  - A
  - B
```

1. Set the cursor on `C`.
2. Activate `bumpThoughtDown`.

## Current Behavior

`C` is moved to be the first sibling and the context is no longer sorted.   

- [empty thought]
  - C
  - A
  - B

## Expected Behavior

The context should stay sorted and `C` should be moved to the correct position. 

- [empty thought]
  - A
  - B
  - C

## Testing

Add a unit test in https://github.com/cybersemics/em/blob/5ffafd3a22beb062ff2b55b87115fe898aea7870/src/actions/__tests__/bumpThoughtDown.ts to cover this case.
